headline: Chess.com launched a poker site and is planning even more classic games
summary: Chess.com, known for online chess for 20 years, has expanded. They quietly launched Gambit, a free online poker site. More classic games are planned for future expansion.

headline: China’s robots race ahead
summary: China is making rapid advancements in humanoid robotics. The country is actively competing in the global AI race. Follow Robert Hart for more on the US-China AI competition.

headline: Two new small, powerful Macs
summary: Apple has introduced two new compact yet powerful Mac models. These releases are part of the latest tech updates. Get ready for enhanced performance in a smaller form factor.

headline: Vicariously hike the Appalachian in the gorgeous A Trail Tale
summary: Experience the Appalachian Trail virtually through 'A Trail Tale'. The game offers a pixel-art rendition of the famous hike. Fulfill your thru-hiking dreams from your device.

headline: PSA: Nintendo Switch 2 Gets a $50 Price Increase on Tuesday
summary: The Nintendo Switch 2 will increase in price by $50. The new price of $500 takes effect on September 1. This is your last chance to buy it at the current price.

headline: Grab Philips Shavers at a Steep Discount at Amazon Right Now
summary: Save hundreds on various Philips Shavers at Amazon. The Prestige Ultra model is now more than half price. Don't miss these significant discounts on electric shavers.

headline: 4 Penny Coffins Lets You Play 19th-Century Detective – Or a 10-Foot Demon Ripping Friends in Half
summary: New game '4 Penny Coffins' blends 'Among Us' with 'Jack the Ripper'. Investigate a social mystery in 1888 Whitechapel. Play in 8-player or solo modes.

headline: The Pokémon Company on PokémonXP's Lottery System, Long Lines, and Limited Access to Workshops
summary: The Pokémon Company addresses PokémonXP event issues. Concerns include the lottery system for entry. Long lines and limited workshop access are also under review.

headline: PC Harper's killers to stay in jail as PM announces changes to early release scheme
summary: Killers of PC Harper will remain in jail. The Prime Minister announced changes to early release. Manslaughter convictions are excluded from the scheme.

headline: Police release one of two men arrested over fatal house fire
summary: One man arrested in connection with a fatal house fire has been released. Police continue to question a 23-year-old suspect. A 7-year-old girl and her aunt died in the blaze.

headline: British woman killed in stabbing at German railway station
summary: A British woman was killed in a stabbing in Germany. The incident occurred at Rosenheim railway station in Bavaria. A 27-year-old German man was immediately arrested.

headline: Church names pastor killed by falling sign at Christian festival
summary: A pastor died after being hit by a falling sign. Robert Guanco, 41, was named as the victim. He served at Jesus the Living Water Church in Eastbourne.
